html:
Indra is a Catalian border fortress on the railway route to Ollandia.

In the text (ch. 4)

In chapter 4, where the reader travels by train from Laerta, it is mentioned as the last stop: a town “compressed by a ring of fortifications like a maiden’s bosom by a corset.” An officer checks the passenger’s papers and wishes them a speedy return to Catalia, while Indra sees the train off with pennants waving from its bastions. Beyond Indra begins a belt of marshes, with the land of the Ollandians on the far side.

On the author’s map

On the author’s map, Indra is labeled in the northern part of the blue region, north of Brega and beside the city of Gerona. There are no other mentions in the text.
